# GPSseq VoxelMorph source snapshot

- This is a repackaged historical VoxelMorph development snapshot supplied for GPSseq.
- Python library code is unchanged; the archive is flattened to make pip installation easy.
- Original example data was removed; **do not assume this archive contains reference atlases**.
- Source package version remains `0.2`, but unlike the PyPI `0.2` release it exposes
  `voxelmorph.tf.networks.VxmAffineFeatureDetector`.
- Archive: `voxelmorph-gpsseq-legacy.zip`.
- SHA256: `06c4dff583805fbb2e74da6263470d4637ac97ee571376da5933f71ac0ec335c`.
- Upstream project: https://github.com/voxelmorph/voxelmorph
- License: Apache-2.0 (embedded `LICENSE.md`).
- Consult `GPSSEQ_PACKAGING_NOTES.md` within the zip for exact packaging differences.
